assess.fakeNote: Until legal review, results come from invented sample data and no real domain is contacted.

outreach.noTemplatesHelp: Write a template, or draft one with AI, to use it in a campaign.
outreach.fromCRM: People in CRM with an email address

outreach.postalAddress: Postal address shown in every email
outreach.noCampaignsHelp: Set up a sending domain and sender, write a template, then create a campaign.

blockers.no_sendable_recipients: Nobody in the audience can be emailed.

outreach.aiWarning: Some text was drafted by AI. The approver should read it carefully.
outreach.approveNote: You are approving exactly the content shown (fingerprint {{hash}}…). Any later change needs a new approval.
outreach.noRepliesHelp: Replies appear here. A reply stops that person's sequence.
outreach.suppressionHelp: Nobody on this list is emailed by any campaign. Addresses are stored only as fingerprints, so they are not shown. Opt-outs, bounces and complaints cannot be removed.
outreach.unsubscribed: You are unsubscribed. {{sender}} will not email you again.
outreach.unsubscribeInvalid: This unsubscribe link is not valid.

modeHelp.opt_in: Visitors are counted anonymously until they accept analytics. Only then are visits linked into sessions.
modeHelp.opt_out: Visits are linked into sessions unless the visitor declines. Check this is allowed where your visitors are.
modeHelp.cookieless_only: Only anonymous page views are counted. Nothing is stored in the visitor's browser.

visitors.noSitesHelp: Add a website to get its install snippet.
visitors.installHelp: Add this to every page of the website, and connect it to your consent banner with window.mspTrack.consent("granted") or ("denied").

ip.truncate_then_discard: On: a shortened network address is checked, then discarded

visitors.privacyNote: IP addresses are never stored. Query strings are removed except utm_ parameters. Visit data is deleted after {{days}} days.
visitors.companiesHelp: Companies matched from visitors' networks. A match is an estimate, not proof of who visited.

chat.fakeNotice: Answers come from the fake AI provider until a real one is approved. Install bots only on the local test site or websites the team controls.
chat.noBotsHelp: Create a bot, give it knowledge, then activate it for your website.
chat.allowedOrigins: Websites it may appear on (comma separated)
chat.disclosureHelp: Visitors always see this notice, so they know they are talking to software.
chat.installHelp: Add this to the website's pages. It only works on the websites listed above.
chat.knowledgeHelp: The bot answers only from this text. If it does not cover a question, the bot passes it to your team.
chat.questionsHelp: Asked when a visitor leaves their details. Answered questions add their weight to the lead's score.
chat.question: Question
chat.noConversationsHelp: Conversations from your website appear here.

expansion.noCustomersHelp: Win a deal or add a customer.
expansion.analysisDone: Analysis done: {{created}} new, {{refreshed}} updated, {{expired}} no longer supported.
expansion.noContractsHelp: A won deal adds one. You can also add one by hand.

review.deal_reopened: The deal was reopened, so this contract is back in draft.

expansion.coverageHelp: Unknown means not recorded. It is never treated as the customer not having a service.
expansion.noServicesHelp: Coverage is recorded against the services you sell.
expansion.runAnalysis: Run analysis on a customer to see suggestions.
expansion.recommendationsHelp: Each suggestion shows the facts behind it. Unknown coverage is a question, not a gap.
expansion.aiWorded: Worded with AI from the facts below

evidenceKinds.assessment_risk: Their IT assessment on {{assessed_at}} found {{risk_level}} risk.

dealSkipped.nothing_to_sell_yet: Accepted. Confirm the coverage first; there is nothing to sell yet.

expansion.dealPending: Accepted. The deal could not be opened yet and will be retried.

intel.notComputedYet: Not computed yet. Numbers appear shortly after activity.

unavailable.module_not_active: The modules that feed this section are not active, and there is no history yet.
unavailable.no_cost_data: Add your costs to see this.

flags.fx_missing: some amounts left out: no exchange rate

intel.movementsHelp: Net new MRR is new + expansion + reactivation − contraction − churn.

intel.costsHelp: Costs are the only figures you enter here. They are spread evenly over their dates.
intel.pipelineHelp: Weighted pipeline is contract value × probability, an estimate.
intel.stageReach: Deals created in {{month}}, by stage reached
intel.noForecastsHelp: A revenue forecast needs 3 months of history.

forecastErrors.forecast_failed: This forecast could not be made.

intel.previousShown: The previous forecast is still available below.
intel.teamHelp: Individual results. Only managers can see this, and each view is logged.
intel.definitionsHelp: Metrics are defined once and calculated the same way everywhere. Campaign attribution looks back {{days}} days; ROI counts {{months}} months of won MRR. Actual, estimated and forecast values are never added together.

billing.buyNote: Card payments are taken when you submit. An administrator then reviews the purchase; if it is not approved, you are refunded.
billing.noPlans: No plans are on sale yet
billing.taxNotCalculated: Tax is not calculated yet. Prices exclude tax.

checkout.testOnly: This is a test payment page. No money moves and no card details are taken.
